sloka: सत्यः सत्य अभिसम्धः च नित्यम् सत्य पराक्रमः ।पर लोक भयात् भीतः निर्भयो अस्तु पिता मम ॥२-२२-९॥
transliteration: satyaḥ satya abhisamdhaḥ ca nityam satya parākramaḥ ।para loka bhayāt bhītaḥ nirbhayo astu pitā mama ॥2-22-9॥

translations.english: Let my father who is always truthful, who is really valiant, who is always striving for truth and who is afraid of the next world, be fearless.
